Commentary.Commentary: Right then. Shikhar Dhawan gets the ODI trophy and he poses with his team as they are celebrating their victory in this series. India are not able to inflict the whitewash as they lose out to Sri Lanka in the final ODI game, but this win will give Sri Lanka a morale boost. That is not all, from this tour, as after the ODI series, the 3-game T20I series will be upon on. The first of those will be played on Sunday, 25th July 2021 at 8 pm local (1430 GMT). We hope to have your company for that game. Until then, cheers!

The Indian captain, Shikhar Dhawan says that things didn't go their way and feels that they had a good start but lost wickets in the middle and hence, couldn't get a good score. Adds that he is happy that so many players got a game after staying in quarantine for a long time and mentions he is okay that he didn't do his best with the bat and always looks to improve. Mentions they were positive that they could defend the total but also knew they were 50 runs short and says that we all make mistakes and learn from them and improve.

SURYAKUMAR YADAV IS THE PLAYER OF THE SERIES. He says that he has been consistent for the past 2-3 years and his success mantra is working for him. Opines that he would have loved to make a big score, but he hopes to get better. On him bowling, he laughs and says that he is ready, if the team needs him to bowl. Feels that the atmosphere in the camp is very positive.

Dasun Shanaka, the Sri Lankan skipper, starts by congratulating India for winning the series and he is happy with the way they played in this game. Praises his bowlers and thinks that his bowlers showed character and hopes that they can continue this form. Tells that the guys need to play more and more cricket to get more reliable. Says that this win is for the fans as it has come after a long time and he thanks the players and the staff. Laughs and cheekily says that he enjoys his captaincy on the field, but not off the field.

AVISHKA FERNANDO IS THE PLAYER OF THE MATCH. He says that if he had done well in the second match, they could have won the match and the series, but is happy with this performance. Adds, after the England tour, he made improvements on his techniques and mentions that we have a very young side, and going forward, he believes that they will do well.
... Stay tuned for the Presentation ...

Earlier in the day, India started off on the right note, as they kept the scoreboard ticking and were scoring runs at a healthy rate, but all that changed, after the rain delay, as the Lankan spinners spun the Indian middle order into a web. It looked like they could cross 300, but folded for a measly score. In the end, Sri Lanka did enough, in all aspects of the game, to win the final game of the series.

Not a very bad bowling display by India, but yes, they did need some more from their bowlers. Cannot even blame them, as many of them were making their ODI debuts and were new to this stage of international cricket. India got a wicket early on, but took a while to get that second one, but by that time, the game was already slipping away from them. They took a couple of quick wickets, but with the total being slightly low, Sri Lanka did not have a lot of issues, closing the game out. Another issue was India's fielding as they dropped a load of catches and who knows, if they had been taken, they could have got something out of this game. Rahul Chahar bowled very well, getting three, whereas Chetan Sakariya got two to his name. Krishnappa Gowtham, too, got one under his belt, but it did not prove to be enough.

Even though the total was not a massive one, the Lankans would have wanted to start off with a bang, which would have eased some nerves and they did, just that. They lost a wicket early on, but the duo of Avishka Fernando and Bhanuka Rajapaksa made it a point to keep going on and not let the Indians have any sniff. Both of them go to their fifties, as they raised a stand of 109 runs, which made the job easier for the Lankans. Chetan Sakariya opened the door slightly for India, by taking 2 quick wickets. Charith Asalanka scored a few quick runs before he fell too. While all of this was going on, Fernando kept a hold on one end and even though Sri Lanka lost a flurry of wickets towards the end, they crossed the line.

Stop the press. Sri Lanka have FINALLY won an ODI game! This is also the first time that Sri Lanka have beaten India in an ODI game, since JULY 2012! It has been a long time coming and this has been a very good display from them to ensure that they get a win, firstly, and secondly, that they avoid getting whitewashed by the Indians.
That's it, Sri Lanka have finally done it! Fuller one on the stumps and Mendis sweeps it fine towards fine leg for the winning run. SRI LANKA WIN BY 3 WICKETS (DLS METHOD)!
SCORES LEVEL! Shorter one on middle, Akila Dananjaya swings at it as it's a Free Hit but gets the top edge just over the bowler's head for a single as the ball landed safely.

FOUR! That was surprising. Tossed up delivery on off and every fielder is close to the batsman, Akila Dananjaya makes use of this and crashes his cover drive into the vacant boundary on the off side. This would have take a lot of pressure off the hosts. NO BALL called as there weren't enough fielders in the ring and a Free Hit is coming up.
Akila Dananjaya is in!

OUT! STUMPED! Sharp work by Samson sees Sri Lanka lose another wicket. Floated, outside off, Chamika Karunaratne looks to defend, but the ball spins away, and evades the outside edge to the keeper, where Samson collects and whips the bails off. Sanju is convinced and the third umpire is called to refer this. Ultra Edge shows no bat. Replays show that the foot was on the line and not behind it, when the bails come off. The third umpire has a couple of looks and decides that this will be out. 7 more needed.
Commentary.Howout: st Sanju Samson b Rahul Chahar

Commentary.Commentary: The googly around middle, defended out.
On middle, swept hard to fine leg for one.
Tossed up, around off, Mendis looks to defend, but the ball takes the pad and goes to the first slip, who pouches this. An appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Around off, pushed to covers. Just 8 more needed now!
Back of a length outside off, Karunaratne covers the line well and defends it nicely.
Short ball on middle, pulled away nicely by Karunaratne towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Slow and full this time outside off, driven straight to short cover.
Back of a length on off, angling in, Karunaratne tries to tuck it on the leg side but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
Slower, back of a length delivery around off. Karunaratne gets behind the line of the ball to block this one.
Well bowled again! Tossed up around off, but left alone.
Tossed up on middle, Mendis brings out the sweep again and gets it down to fine leg for a couple. Just 10 needed now!
Tossed up on off, pushed to deep point for a single.
Flighted on off, blocked back by Karunaratne.

OUT! CAUGHT! Chahar is spinning a web today! Bowls the stock leg-spinner on middle and this one turns sharply, catching the outside edge of Fernando, who was looking to block it. Shaw takes a sharp catch, low down to his right, at first slip. Avishka Fernando is finally out for 76 after a wonderful knock. He might have done enough to see his team through.
Commentary.Howout: c Prithvi Shaw b Rahul Chahar

Commentary.Commentary: Chamika Karunaratne comes out. Just 13 more needed!
Flighted shorter around off, punched to deep cover for a single by Mendis.
Back of a length on middle, blocked back by Fernando.
Length around off, angling in, nicely fended off by Fernando.
Overpitched outside off, driven through the cover region for a single.
Change of pace, on top of off and Mendis gets behind the ball to block it.
Length ball around off, tapped off the front foot towards cover.
Length outside off, guided nicely to third man for a single.
Full toss on off, driven down to long off by Fernando for a single.
Shorter one around off, punched off the back foot to the point region.
Tossed up on middle and swept straight to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! NICELY DONE! Fuller one on middle, Mendis gets down on his knees and sweeps it fine behind square leg and into the boundary.
Similar deliver but this time turning from middle, Mendis tries to block but gets the outside edge down to third man for a couple.
PEACH! That was probably the delivery of the day. Tosses this one up on off, the ball turns sharply and beats the outside edge of Mendis.
Back of a length around off, punched off the back foot to deep point for one. Just 24 needed now off 78 balls!
FOUR LEG BYES! Hardik drifts down leg and pays the price. Mendis looks to flick but the ball goes off the pads and into the boundary.
Length ball outside off, Fernando taps this one down to third man for another single.
Length ball around off, nudged towards mid-wicket by Mendis for one.
Length ball outside off, guided down to third man for a single.
Back of a length on middle, dabbed into the ground on the leg side.
Tossed up again on off, pushed off the back foot towards covers.

EDGED AND DROPPED! Tossed up on off, spinning away again and Mendis gets the outside edge, but Shaw drops a low chance at second slip. If he had taken this, would have been a big moment in this game as the pressure could have pushed India further in the game.

OUT! CAUGHT! The skipper, Dasun Shanaka has been dismissed for a golden duck by Rahul Chahar! Floats this one up nicely around off, turning away and Shanaka pushes at it and gets the leading edge straight to short cover, where Manish Pandey pouches this. Chahar has his maiden ODI wicket! Is there still life left in this match?
Commentary.Howout: c Manish Pandey b Rahul Chahar

Commentary.Commentary: Ramesh Mendis is out now.
Tossed up on off, pushed down to long off for a single.
BEAUTY! Fuller one, again tossed up outside off, Fernando looks to push at it but gets beaten comprehensively.
Nicely floated outside off, spins away, Fernando taps it towards point.
The Sri Lankan skipper, Dasun Shanaka walks out.

Review time. Sri Lanka have taken a review for the LBW decision which was given OUT onfield. The delivery was really full and hit Charith Asalanka in front, the review shows that this one is as straight as it gets and would hit the base of middle. Review lost and Asalanka is back to the pavilion.

OUT! LBW! Hardik finally gets a wicket and India get their fourth, but it seems like it has come too late. A slower dipping full toss, on middle and leg, Asalanka looks to clip this gently to the leg side, but he misses and gets hit on his boot. An appeal from Hardik, a polite enquiry, actually, and the umpire raises his finger. Charith Asalanka takes the review but it just confirms that the ball would go onto hit the wickets. 33 more needed in 90 balls.
On a good length, around off, pushed through covers for a single.

FIVE WIDES. Way too high, for the batter, and also the keeper. On a shortish length, on middle, Avishka Fernando leans back and looks to upper cut. Misses and Sanju Samson misses too. The ball goes to the ropes.
Again, a short ball, on middle, pulled to deep square leg, for one.
On the body, worked to the leg side this time.
FOUR! Pleasing cover drive and Charith Asalanka gets another boundary. On a length, around off, Charith Asalanka opens the face of the bat at the right time and punches this through extra cover.
Around off, guided to third man for one.
Around off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! Finds the gap this time. A touch flatter again, outside off, Charith Asalanka makes some room and slaps this through the point region for a boundary.
On a shorter length, outside off, Charith Asalanka shuffles and cuts this to the right of the backward point fielder.
Fuller, on middle, this is reverse swept through backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Pushed through mid on for a single.
Tossed up, on middle, Avishka Fernando skips down the track and whips this over the mid-wicket fielder. Manish Pandey hops and takes this, but the ball pops out and lands down.
A well directed short ball, on middle and leg, Charith Asalanka just sits under this one. 52 needed off 102 balls.
Gently pushed to the mid off region.
Shows the full face of the blade and keeps the ball out.
On the pads, on a length, Charith misses his tuck and gets hit on the pad.
Good length ball, around off, steered past the point fielder, to the left of third man, for a couple of runs.
A touch shorter, outside off, steered to third man, for one.
WIDE. Down the leg side, on a length, Fernando looks to pull, but misses. Wided.

DRINKS BREAK. India, and especially, Chetan Sakariya have done well in the past 10 overs to stem the flow of runs as Chetan took 2 wickets and applied some pressure on the hosts. But, with the total being low, pushing the ball around, for singles and doubles, will see Sri Lanka cross the line. They just need 56 more in 108 balls and if they continue in the same way for the next 10 overs, then they should coast home. But who knows? A couple of wickets and the game can turn on it's head. Let's see who takes the game.

FOUR! A boundary on the last ball. Shortish, outside off, Charith Asalanka waits for the ball and then late cuts it past short third man, for a boundary. Navdeep Saini jogs behind the ball, but the ball wins the race to the ball.
Gives it air and lands it around off, poked to point.
Walks down and eases this to long on for a single.
On off, shortish, punched to the bowler.
Floated, around off, CA taps it to covers for one.
On the pads, worked to the leg side for one.
Slower full toss on off, driven single-handedly towards the covers.
Back of a length again around off, tapped back into the pitch by Asalanka.
Good bouncer outside off, Asalanka decides not to play at it.
Overpitched on middle, nudged towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Another length ball around off, angling across and left alone once again.
Length ball outside off, Asalanka leaves it alone.
Slower length ball around middle, tucked off the back foot towards deep sqaure leg for a single by Asalanka.
Pitched up outside off, a bit slower again, pushed to point for a single.
Back of a length on middle, pulled towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, nudged to backward point for one.
Full on off, driven through point into the deep for a single by Asalanka.
Swinging full toss on the pads, Fernando misses out and manages to flick it down to fine leg for one. Another NO BALL by Chetan Sakariya, Free Hit coming up again!
Length ball on top of off, Fernando gets behind the line to block it. NO BALL called by the third umpire! Free Hit time!
Fuller one around off, driven straight to mid on.
Length ball on off, angling across and Asalanka leaves it alone.
Length ball on off, pushed to the cover region. Slight mix-up and the direct hit would have had him!
Back of a length outside off, dabbed into the ground towards point for a single.
Length ball on middle, pushed towards mid-wicket for one.
Length ball on the legs, tucked to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller one outside off, pushed to the cover region.
Charith Asalanka makes his way out. 76 needed in 132 balls for the Lankans. Navdeep Saini gets the ball again.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Chetan Sakariya is on fire! Could this be a way back into the match for India? Bowls this one into the pitch, on off but it's a slower one and takes off after pitching, Dhananjaya de Silva who was looking to block it, has no idea about this, looks to defend, but the ball has popped up off his gloves, straight in the air. Sakariya runs forward and pouches it.
Pitched up delivery on off, driven straight to cover.
Back of a length on leg stump, de Silva looks to flick but gets it on the thigh pad.
CLOSE! Fuller one on middle, de Silva looks to flick but gets the inside edge onto the pads.
Back of a length around off, guided down to third man for one.
WIDE! Length ball straying down leg, Fernando looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Length ball on off, tapped towards point.
Gets behind the line of the ball and defends the ball out.
Flatter and around off, quicker too, slammed to long on for a single.
NO BALL. A shortish googly, around off, knocked through mid-wicket for one. Rahul Chahar has overstepped and it is a no ball. Free Hit coming up too.
Gently eased to the long on region for a single.
On middle, worked to the leg side for one.
Around off, pushed to point.
Around off, tossed up, kept out.
Bowling change. Rahul Chahar comes back into the attack.
Who will come in at number 4? It's Dhananjaya de Silva.

OUT! CAUGHT! And now, the catch is taken. A sliding effort and after a massive partnership, India finally gets a wicket. This is bowled on the pads, on a length, Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to help this one over the fine leg region and whips it, off his hips. Gets the height, but not the distance. The man at fine leg, Krishnappa Gowtham, runs to his right, and slides to complete this catch. Bhanuka Rajapaksa will be unhappy that he could not stay out there for longer, but he has done what was needed off him. 83 needed in 144 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Krishnappa Gowtham b Chetan Sakariya

Commentary.Commentary: DROPPED AND FOUR! That should have been taken by Rana. It was a straightforward chance, but Nitish drops this and what's more? It goes for a boundary. A length delivery, around off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa hooks this one to the deep square leg region, where Rana palms it past the ropes, for a boundary.
Around off, worked to the mid on region.
Outside off on a length, punched to the left of sweeper cover and a couple is taken.
On a length, on middle and leg, Bhanuka Rajapaksa misses his clip to the leg side, but misses and gets pinged on the pad. An appeal but the umpire feels it is sliding down leg.
A slower full ball, around off, drilled to covers.
On middle, worked to the leg side for a single. 89 more needed here.
Defended out well by Bhanuka.

FOUR! The 100-run partnership comes up between these two. What a stand it has been. Will want to keep going on, though. Slightly shorter, outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa waits for the ball to come and then steers this one to the third man fence.
Fired on the pads, flicked to deep square leg, for one.
This is gently eased back to the bowler.
Shortish and on middle, nudged to the leg side.
Bowling change. Krishnappa Gowtham comes back into the attack. So far, he has 1/29 off his 5 overs.
On a fuller length, on middle, worked to the leg side.
Angled into the off pole, Bhanuka looks to work it to the leg side but the ball takes the leading edge and goes to point, on the bounce.
FOUR! Again, on a shorter length, straying down leg, Bhanuka Rajapaksa pulls this one to fine leg and gets a boundary.
A length ball, outside off, BR looks to have a poke, but gets beaten.
On the pads, whipped to fine leg for a single.
A back of a length ball, around off, pushed back to Chetan.
Shorter one, pushed off the back foot towards cover.
FOUR! FIFTY for Bhanuka Rajapaksa! Reverses the tossed up delivery on middle past point and into the boundary to bring up a maiden ODI half-century.
Chetan Sakariya (2-0-9-0) returns into the attack.
FOUR! SLAPPED! Tossed up delivery around off and Bhanuka slogs it flat towards the deep mid-wicket where Sakariya puts in a good effort to catch the ball but goes off his palms into the boundary.
Shorter one on leg stump, spinning towards middle, nicely tucked towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller delivery, pushed to mid on.
Nicely flighted on off, Bhanuka comes down the pitch to chip the ball down to long off for one.
Tossed up and Fernando pushes it towards covers. 110 needed from 168 balls.
A bit short and pushed off the back foot for a single down to long on.
This one is pushed wider and Bhanuka slogs it across, but not off the middle, in the gap towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Slightly shorter on middle, tapped to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller one on off, pushed to point for a quick single.
Loopy around off, played down to long on for a single by Fernando.
Good length around off, turning in and nicely blocked by Bhanuka.
Nicely floated on off, driven down to long off for one.
There is a slight halt in play as the there is a problem with the bails.
Nicely tossed up around off, Fernando looks to block but is comprehensively beaten.
Tossed up again and use of the feet again by Bhanuka, who checks his lofted drive in the end to get it to long on for a single.
FOUR! HAMMERED! Flighted delivery outside off and Bhanuka dances down the track to loft it over covers, against the spin for a boundary.
Shorter ball on middle, pushed off the back foot to long on for one.
Fifty for Avishka Fernando! Pushes the tossed up delivery to cover for a single and brings up a well compiled half-century.
Shorter ball, pushed to mid on.

CHANCE....BUT DROPPED! The Indian skipper puts in a good attempt, but he is not able to hold on. Full outside off, Bhanuka slaps it across towards short mid-wicket. Shikhar flies to his left but just couldn't hang on to take a blinder of a catch. A single is taken.
Darted in and well blocked by Bhanuka.
Slightly shorter on middle, Fernando nudges it on the leg side for a single.
Flighted ball on off, pushed to the cover region.
Cheeky shot from Bhanuka. Tossed up on middle and just helped on its way over leg slip for a couple of runs.
Flighted delivery around off, Fernando comes forward and drives it down to long on for one.
Tossed up on middle, pushed to long on for a single.
FOUR BYES! Fuller ball, flighted on middle, spins away. Bhanuka comes down the track but gets beaten by the turn and bounce and in the end, it misses everyone, racing into the boundary.
Shorter one, pushed off the back foot to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on off, turns away, tapped to slip by Fernando.

DRINKS BREAK. This was just the start that the Lankans needed, chasing a total, which was sub-par. They lost a wicket early but since then, Rajapaksha and Fernando have played well and smart, raising a 50-run stand in the process too. They have amassed 92 in the first 15 overs and need 135 from 192 balls. If these two can continue for the next 40-45 minutes, then they can drag this game away from the Men in Blue. The visitors need to break this stand and do it quickly too. Let's see what happens in this next phase.
Floated around off, pushed to long off for one. Just one off the over, then.
It is a full ball, around off. Avishka Fernando presses forward and defends.
A touch shortish, outside off, punched to point. It's been nice and tight from Rana, so far.
Gets his bat behind the ball and blocks it out.
Shortish and outside off, spins in, Avishka Fernando goes back and taps this to covers.
Outside off, pushed to covers.
Bowling change. The debutant, Nitish Rana is coming in to roll his arm.
Presses forward to a full ball and defends it out. 136 needed in 198 balls.
Shimmies down the track and works this to the long on region. One run.
On off, pushed to the bowler.
Darted on middle, Fernando works this to the fine leg region and a couple is taken.
WIDE. Down the leg side and it is wided.
FOUR! Cheeky! So delicately played. Outside off, a touch shorter, Avishka Fernando waits for the ball to arrive and then guides it late towards third man, for a boundary.
TWO LEG BYES. On middle and leg, AF misses his tuck and the ball takes the pad and Sanju Samson fails to collect the ball too. Hardik Pandya at fine leg mops up. Two leg byes taken.

FOUR! Second boundary of the over and it is Chetan Sakariya, who is not able to stop the ball cleanly. A touch fuller, around off, driven with purpose through extra cover. Chetan Sakariya runs to his left, dives perfectly, pulls the ball back, but the ball hits his other arm and goes past the ropes.
WIDE. On a length, down the leg side, BR misses his tuck and it is a wide.
Short of a length, on middle, Bhanuka Rajapaksa awkwardly gets his bat down, which sees the ball take the inside edge, and hits him on the pad.
Around off, dabbed to the off side.

INSIDE EDGE AND FOUR! Lady luck with Bhanuka Rajapaksa here. Pandya cut him into half, but it went past the keeper. A back of a length ball, around off, the ball nips in, Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to defend, but the ball takes the inside edge, goes past Samson's dive, to the fence.
Around off, on a length, pushed to the cover region.
A length delivery, on leg, nicely clipped to fine leg for one.
Quicker on middle, nudged to the leg side for a quick single.
Around off, tossed up, lofted over covers for one.
Fuller and on leg, Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pad.
Around off, defended out.

Floated, around off, coming in, Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to defend, but seems to have hit him on the pad. An appeal but turned down. The camera pans to Shikhar Dhawan, who does not take the review. A good call not to take the review, as replays show the ball to be missing the stumps.
Tossed up, around off, knocked to long on for one.
FOUR! Really good bouncer on middle, Bhanuka again looks to pull but he's beaten for pace and gets a faint edge over the keeper's head for another boundary. 13 off HP's first over!
FOUR! Short one on off but not short enough, Bhanuka pulls it across in front of square on the leg side and into the boundary.
Good bumper on top of middle, hits Bhanuka on the helmet as he did not pick up the length.
Fuller delivery pushed wide, Bhanuka throws his hands at it and lofts it over covers for a couple of runs.
Length ball on the pads, flicked to deep square leg for one.
Back of a length on middle, tucked fine towards square leg for a couple by Fernando.
The umpire signals that it is time for Powerplay 2! A maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle, until the end of the 38th over. Also, Hardik Pandya to have a go now!
Tossed up nicely just outside off, Bhanuka lets it go through to the keeper. Sri Lanka are at 55/1 at the end of Powerplay 1, they still need 172 in 222 balls!
Nicely flighted around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed up on middle, Bhanuka gets behind the ball to block it.
FOUR! Short but not that wide, Bhanuka moves away and cuts it behind point into the boundary.
Tossed up on middle, pushed down the ground for a single.
Flatter delivery and flicked straight to mid-wicket.
Good quick delivery served on a length outside off. Beats the batsman's inside edge as he looked to work it to the leg side.
FOUR! Back of a length outside off, looking to smash it through point but gets the toe end and past the bowler and into the fence, down the ground.
Pitched up around off, sliced to third man for one.
Back of a length into the body, dabbed down to mid on by Fernando.
Length ball on top of off, defended by Fernando.
Back of a length on leg stump, turned off the hips towards square leg for a couple.
Navdeep Saini returns. Gave 15 runs off his 2 overs.
Tossed up around off, Rajapaksa blocks it off the front foot.
Flighted on middle, Fernando pushes this one down to long on for one.
Good length delivery on middle, pushed to mid on by Fernando.
Flatter one on the legs, nudged onto the leg side for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Fernando pushes it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Shorter one on off, coming into the body. Blocked to the on side.
Tossed up around middle, Rajapaksa checks his shot and blocks it back to the bowler.
A bit flatter on off, solidly defended by Rajapaksa.
Tossed up and fuller on leg stump, blocked back to the bowler.
Shorter one, tucked towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up on off, pushed to the cover region.
FOUR! Floated outside off, gloriously driven through the cover region and into the fence by Fernando.
Tossed up outside off, beats the outside edge as Rajapaksa looks to block it.
Tossed up around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Flighted delivery on middle, Rajapaksa blocks it away.

OUT! CAUGHT! First wicket in International cricket for Krishnappa Gowtham and India gets an early wicket! Full and straight on middle, Bhanuka sweeps it straight down to square leg. Chetan Sakariya takes a nice low catch and India have the first breakthrough.
Commentary.Howout: c Chetan Sakariya b Krishnappa Gowtham

Commentary.Commentary: Bhanuka Rajapaksa will be the new batter in.
Slightly tossed up on middle, pushed to mid-wicket for a single.
FIVE WIDES! Trying to bowl quicker and flatter, straying down leg. Fernando looks to flick but misses and it is missed by the keeper too. The ball races into the fence.
FOUR! Krishnappa Gowtham starts with a short one on leg stump, Avishka Fernando dispatches it towards the fine leg boundary.
Change. Spin from both ends, then. Krishnappa Gowtham is into the attack.
Quicker and flatter on middle, stays a touch low, Bhanuka works it back to the bowler.
Eased past the fielder at mid off and the strike is rotated.
A touch shorter, around off, Avishka Fernando looks to have a poke at this, but the ball spins away, to the keeper's mitts.
Around off, fuller and tossed up, eased to covers.

An appeal for LBW but turned down. Floated, around off and middle, Fernando looks to slog sweep this one away but misses and gets hit on his chest. The appeal is turned down, as it looked to be spinning away.
Quicker through the air, on middle, Fernando goes back and taps this to the leg side.
Bowling change. Rahul Chahar comes on to bowl, on debut.
Outside off, slower ball, Minod swings but misses.
FOUR! Well played. Comes down the track to this length ball and tonks it over the mid off region for a boundary.
Outside off, chopped away to point.
Around off, pushed to covers.
Around middle, nudged to the leg side.
Width offered outside off, hit straight to the fielder at covers.
Outside off, guided to third man, for one. 10 from the over!

Well fielded by Pandey! A back of a length delivery, around off, Avishka Fernando goes back and punches  this through cover-point. Manish Pandey and Suryakumar Yadav chase after this and MP pulls the ball back, before the ropes. Three.
Worked towards mid-wicket again, by Fernando.
Around middle, nudged to mid-wicket.
Around off, pushed to the right of mid off, where the Indian captain, Shikhar Dhawan dives that side and stops the ball.
SIX! WOW! Uses the pace of the bowler and gets a biggie. On a shortish length, around the body, Avishka Fernando just pulls this one all the way over fine leg for a biggie.
Pitched up, outside off, slower in length, Minod Bhanuka looks to play at this, but gets beaten.
Around off, defended watchfully.
On the body, helped through square leg for one.
Closer to the off pole, on a length, AF pushes it back to the bowler.

FOUR! First boundary of the run chase and Avishka Fernando takes the attack to the debutant. On a length, outside off, there is width to play with and Avishka Fernando flays this one through the cover region. Boundary.
A back of a length delivery to start off by Chetan, it is angling in, Avishka Fernando hops and awkwardly fends this out to the cover region.
Who is going to bowl from the other end? It's the debutant, Chetan Sakariya.
Another short ball, around off, Minod looks to hook this one to the leg side, but he misses his shot. 5 off the opening over!
On a shortish length, around off, hooked to Shikhar Dhawan at mid-wicket.
WIDE. A length ball, way outside off, Minod Bhanuka slashes hard, but he misses. Wide signalled. The Free Hit continues.
NO BALL. A bumper on middle, Minod sits under this one. Navdeep Saini has overstepped and it is a no ball. Free Hit coming up..
Around off, poked to the man at point.
EDGY COUPLE! Flew over the cover fielder. On a good length, on middle, the ball catches the leading edge, as Minod looks to flick, and goes over the fielder at covers, and the batters take a brace.
Angles in a length ball, across the leftie, Minod Bhanuka looks to have a poke at this, but gets beaten, on the outside edge.
Sri Lanka and Avishka Fernando are underway here. Around off, a length ball, pushed through the cover region, for a quick run.
